Stop! Taurus, the stars are screaming at you right now, and you must listen.

Venus, your ruling planet of Earth, is squaring Mars in Aries in your 12th House of quiet surrender, while the Full Moon in Aries sextiles your Sun in Taurus in the 10th House of career. This tense square forces you to release stubborn routines and rebuild confidence through honest action.

In love, Venus clashes with Mars today, so attraction feels intense but impatient. If partnered, watch for sharp words during power struggles; if single, your aura of self-worth is magnetic, and someone drawn to your stability may appear.

Career and money need Venusian patience, but Mars urges bold moves. Avoid risky shortcuts in your 2nd House finances.

A surprise opportunity or emotional release is coming your way, so breathe. Your breakthrough is already waiting.

Follow for tomorrow's reading now.
